narr: A very slow-moving storm system remained over southeastern New Mexico on August 13, 2021. Combined with an abundant amount of atmospheric moisture, another active monsoon day was underway across eastern New Mexico. Steering flow was once again fast enough to limit a widespread flash flooding threat, however, some thunderstorms did produce heavy rainfall in a short period of time. A strong thunderstorms with heavy rainfall near Nogal did force the closure of a highway as the roadway became unsafe for travel.
ev: Heavy rain near Nogal forced the closure of U.S. Highway 380 from mile marker 74 to mile marker 76. Per a trained spotter, the bridge in the area was unsafe to cross as road surfaces had been damaged from repeated rounds of heavy rain over the summer.
lsr: HIGHWAY 380 CLOSED BETWEEN MM74 AND MM76
